content.what_it_is: MATLAB script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tohoku_tsunami simple case that plots the Pacific-scale bathymetry used by the case. It loads the ASCII depth grid ../external_files/depth_30min.txt (L2), derives grid dimensions [n,m] (L4), builds geographic coordinates at 0.5-degree spacing: lon x=[0:m-1]*0.5+132.01667, lat y=[0:n-1]*0.5-59.98333 (L5-L8), sets a 6x4-inch figure (L11-L13), draws pcolor(x,y,-dep) with interpolated shading and a DEM colormap via demcmap(dep) (L16-L17), labels axes Lat/Lon (L19-L20), and forces the zbuffer renderer (L23). Colorbar code is commented out (L21-L22). No file output.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)

io.name: pcolor of -dep in lon/lat with DEM colormap

unresolved: Origin offsets 132.01667 E and -59.98333 (L7-L8) place the grid start; the file name says 30min (0.5 degree) consistent with dx=dy=0.5, but the actual coverage depends on m,n of depth_30min.txt, not visible here.
demcmap (L17) requires the Mapping Toolbox; no fallback is provided.
params_defined is empty because the script has no user-input parameter block distinct from its constants; all named assignments are listed in constants/entities.
